entities.name: N-(5-phosphoribosyl)anthranilate isomerase
observations: The 205-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry B7J4T0 from Acidithiobacillus ferrooxidans.
The protein contains the PRAI domain PF00697 spanning approximately residues 6–200.
Annotated EC number is EC 5.3.1.24; GO molecular function is phosphoribosylanthranilate isomerase activity.

entities.name: PRAI isomerization
observations: EC 5.3.1.24 / Rhea RHEA:21540: N-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)anthranilate isomerizes to 1-(2-carboxyphenylamino)-1-deoxy-D-ribulose 5-phosphate.
This is step 3 of 5 in the L-tryptophan biosynthetic pathway from chorismate.

entities.name: L-tryptophan biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes the third step of L-tryptophan biosynthesis from chorismate.
